method: Production binaries; CUPTI CPU/CUDA tracing after 10 warmups; 30 samples; median of per-sample max across EP2 ranks; ranges attributed through CUDA launch correlations. Weight preparation excluded; FP8 dW BF16. GPU phase span is first-to-last GPU event and may overlap another phase; do not add spans or per-kernel medians.

benchmark.measurement_scope: eager forward+backward+release+device synchronize; input preparation excluded
benchmark.forward_timing_scope: host API boundary (not synchronized CUDA phase timing)
benchmark.checkpoint: row FP8 X + row FP8 FC1 gate/up; BWD column conversion once; recompute gated SwiGLU in backward
